searchText: what is the reason of not switching `AttestationData` and `PayloadAttestationData` to a `ProgressiveContainer` supertype? is this because they are in dependency from their enclosing `Attestation` type and if there is any change required to the `AttestationData` it should basically introduce a new `AttestationData` ? `AttestationData` is super difficult to change in implementations (remember the electra mess?), akin to `Validator` or `BeaconBlockHeader`. and yeah if we ever need sth new, just create a new one. `PayloadAttestationData` just for symmetry. there's also downstream effects to web3signer etc if messing with these. makes sense, thanks <@881905303011086387> apparently I am missing that electra mess as i've recently started to work on another one 😄 Hey CL clients, would be be fine with [this change](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5697) to the gossip test formats? Delete the global `current_time_ms` output and change `offset_ms` to `current_time_ms` in the per-message outputs.

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: what is the reason of not switching `AttestationData` and `PayloadAttestationData` to a `ProgressiveContainer` supertype?

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: is this because they are in dependency from their enclosing `Attestation` type and if there is any change required to the `AttestationData` it should basically introduce a new `AttestationData` ?

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
`AttestationData` is super difficult to change in implementations (remember the electra mess?), akin to `Validator` or `BeaconBlockHeader`. 
and yeah if we ever need sth new, just create a new one. `PayloadAttestationData` just for symmetry.
there's also downstream effects to web3signer etc if messing with these.

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: makes sense, thanks <@881905303011086387> apparently I am missing that electra mess as i've recently started to work on another one 😄

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Hey CL clients, would be be fine with [this change](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5697) to the gossip test formats? Delete the global `current_time_ms` output and change `offset_ms` to `current_time_ms` in the per-message outputs.
